network_enforcement: The checker invokes the narrow proof replay inside Bubblewrap --unshare-net. The root filesystem is mounted read-only, then Formalizations/Lean is rebound writable because the existing replay script creates and removes a temporary module there; the checker rejects any leftover replay directory. The shared warm dependency cache and writable project subtree make this explicitly nonrelease evidence rather than a cold hermetic release reproduction.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line PASS/BLOCKED release status summary

scope_boundary: Fail-closed worker reconciliation of immutable provisional proof and validation receipts plus a fresh narrow warm-cache Lean replay. It cannot master-accept the validation dependency, reconcile the frozen external route or authoritative graph, supply H0/R0 or AUDIT-Z, accept foundation/provenance/TCB closure, provide a clean cold offline build, independent attestations or verifier, protected CI, or assemble a deterministic release bundle.
